question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who overperformed their xG by the most (goals minus xG)?
answer:
**Phil Foden** overperformed his xG by the most in 2023-2024, scoring **19 goals** against an xG of **11.308** — an overperformance of **+7.692**.

The next closest were Michael Olise (+4.313) and Cole Palmer (+4.168).
sql:
SELECT p.player_name,
       SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals,
       SUM(pss.xg_pss) AS xg,
       SUM(pss.goals_pss) - SUM(pss.xg_pss) AS overperformance
FROM player_season_stats pss
JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id = pss.season_id AND s.season = '2023-2024'
JOIN players p ON p.player_id = pss.player_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(pss.goals_pss) >= 10
ORDER BY overperformance DESC;

out.notes: Use player_season_stats filtered to season_id for '2023-2024' (join seasons on season='2023-2024' to get season_id). Filter goals_pss >= 10, compute goals_pss - xg_pss as overperformance, ORDER BY DESC. Grain is one row per (player_id, season_id, team_id); if a player moved mid-season they may have multiple rows—aggregate by player_id if needed. Join players(player_id) for player_name display. Alternatively use vw_player_season_summary which already has player_name and is filtered to ENG-PL.
